optionsProfilesHint: Profiles decide what is recorded. Presets are read-only: duplicate one to edit it. Any profile can be deleted except the ones from your organization's policy; recording needs at least one.
optionsRulesHint: Rules only pick a profile for a page; recording always starts manually. If the profile changes while recording, the recording stops.
optionsProfilesEmpty: No profiles left: recording is disabled until you restore the recommended profiles or import profiles.
optionsArchiveSaveFailed: The browser refused to store the archive settings.
optionsLeaveBody: Save them before you switch sections, or discard them. Discard drops every unsaved change: {sections}.
optionsLeaveBlockedBody: Some fields are invalid, so nothing can be saved yet. Stay to fix them, or discard every unsaved change: {sections}.
optionsSensitivityHint: What is masked before data leaves the page. Applies to the Default profile.
optionsPointerHint: How often pointer and scroll movement is sampled.
optionsSamplingHint: Where the extension runs, buffer length and capture cadence; lower values cost less CPU.
optionsBudgetsHint: Warn when a page breaks these performance limits.
optionsExportHint: Limits for exported archives and the Player they are opened in.
optionsTransferHint: Share profiles and rules with your team as one JSON file.
optionsErrorTitleRegex: Not a usable title pattern (check the syntax; backreferences and lookarounds are not allowed).
optionsEncryptionNote: Every archive is encrypted (AES-GCM) with a passphrase of at least 8 characters, asked for at export. Privacy scanner findings are shown after an export and never block it.
optionsLanguagePendingReload: Language saved. Save or discard your changes, then reopen this page to see it.
optionsLanguageFollowsBrowser: Auto follows Chrome's language. The popup and Sessions page switch the next time they open.
